caption: StoneMor, Inc. v. International Brotherhood of Teamsters, Local 469
citation_line: StoneMor, Inc. v. International Brotherhood of Teamsters, Local 469, No. 3:22-cv-01388; aff’d, No. 23-1489 (3d Cir. July 10, 2024)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Castner vacated a labor-arbitration award after concluding that the arbitrator disregarded unambiguous CBA language making the agreement binding at ratification and requiring a grievance within ten days.
qualification_rationale: The case defines an important limit on the ordinarily extraordinary deference given to labor arbitrators: an arbitrator may not rewrite clear contractual timing and effective-date terms.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed in a precedential opinion.
